english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for caring about or paying attention to something, especially in negative sentences like 唔理.
Use this for paying attention to or getting involved with a person or matter, especially in “mind your own business.”
Use this when bother means care about or pay attention to something, not when someone is annoying.

examples.english: I don't care what he says.
